text: The **Hansen Global Forest Change (GFC-2025-v1.13)** dataset detected the 2021 tree-cover loss. It identified **81.3 hectares (2.23% of the asset)** of stand-replacing loss within the asset boundary. The detection was corroborated by the **JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020) dataset**, which confirmed that **98% of the event area** was forested in 2020. The **MGAP 2021 forest map** further classified the affected area as **planted forest (68.1 ha, primarily *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*)**, with no native forest loss. The Hansen dataset’s 30-meter resolution and annual monitoring (2001–2025) provided the primary evidence, while JRC and MGAP supported spatial and contextual validation.
